nuggets.text: The Bearcats nickname began in 1914 with a cheer for fullback Teddy Baehr: 'We have a Baehr-cat on our side.'
JC French IV ran for three touchdowns against Boston College, the first Bearcats QB to do that since Desmond Ridder in 2020.
The Bearcats have now won 25 straight home openers, the latest a 34-15 win over Boston College.
Safety MJ Cannon had an interception and a forced fumble in his Bearcats debut against Boston College.
Bearcats coach Scott Satterfield called the plays for Appalachian State's famous 2007 upset of No. 5 Michigan.
The Bearcats' Nippert Stadium opened in 1915 and is the fourth-oldest playing site in college football.
The Bearcats' field at Nippert Stadium runs north-northeast to south-southwest instead of the usual north-south.
The Bearcats' Nippert Stadium field was lowered 12 feet in 1936 to make room for more seats.
The Bearcats' Sept. 19 game against Miami (Ohio) will be the first football game ever played at TQL Stadium.
The Bearcats were the first Group of Five team to reach the College Football Playoff, in the 2021 season.
